description: After you claimed your receive leg on-chain with your OWN wallet (secret from get_deal_secret), report the revealed secret + claim tx so the counterparty and watchers can settle the other leg. Not needed after claim_leg, which reports its own claim. Your own secret goes through the same gate as get_deal_secret first.

leg.description: Optional; if given, the leg you claimed — the one that pays you

secret.description: 64-char hex preimage (from get_deal_secret or the on-chain claim)

swap_id.description: Swap id (swap.id from deal_status, or swapId once a deal is agreed)

name: reveal_claim

error.description: Set instead when the call failed

title: Report your own-wallet claim
